name: gizza-ai/totp-generator
summary: Generate a TOTP (2FA) code from a secret.

tool.description: Generate a time-based one-time code (TOTP, RFC 6238 — the 2FA codes authenticator apps show) from a base32 secret. Uses the current time by default (pass timestamp to compute a code for a specific Unix time). digits (6-8, default 6), period (seconds, default 30), and algorithm (sha1 default / sha256 / sha512) are configurable. Returns the code and how many seconds it stays valid. Runs locally — the secret never leaves the device.

secret.description: The TOTP shared secret, base32-encoded (spaces and case are ignored).

digits.description: Number of digits in the code (6, 7, or 8; default 6).

algorithm.description: HMAC hash algorithm (default sha1, the standard for authenticator apps).

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds to compute the code at; omit or 0 for the current time.
